trigger.description: ee context finds an L2 cache entry for the canonical context key, but the entry payload is malformed, has the wrong schema, mismatches the key, or fails body-hash validation. The corrupt entry is ignored and fresh context assembly proceeds.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Run cargo fmt before release.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule

expected_emission.repair_string: Remove the corrupt cache entry or lower the L2 cache TTL.
